draft_metadata.classification_reason: 咔唑霉素（carbazomycins）属于咔唑类生物碱，论文核心目标是鉴定其生物合成基因簇并阐明甲基化步骤的催化机制。主要实验为 OSMAC 引导的天然产物发掘、cbz 基因簇的生物信息学定位、cbzMT 的体内敲除-回补验证、以及体外酶促反应证明迭代式甲基化，因此按生物合成骨架归入生物碱类，酶工程甲基转移酶作为相关类别。原文正文第 1 页 (PDF page 1) 关键词 carbazole/carbazomycins/O-methyltransferase；正文第 3 页 Fig. 2C 给出完整生物合成途径；正文第 5–6 页 Table 1 列出 cbz 簇注释。

verified_claims.claim: ΔcbzMT 不再产生咔唑霉素 A 和 B，并累积 11–13 混合物（m/z 226.54 与 228.58）
verified_claims.evidence: 'The ΔcbzMT mutant did not produce carbazomycins A and B (1 and 2), and only accumulated at a small amount, resulting in a new peak'；'m/z values of 228.58 and 226.54'

verified_claims.claim: 回补株 ΔcbzMT::cbzMT 中 2 恢复至 WT 约 40%，1 比 WT 高 1.9 倍
verified_claims.evidence: 'The yield of 2 in the ΔcbzMT::cbzMT strain was restored to approximately 40 % of the WT strain'；'the yield of 1 in the ΔcbzMT::cbzMT strain was 1.9-fold higher than in the WT strain'

verified_claims.claim: CbzMT 为 349 aa，38.3 kDa，class I MTase，与 OMTA 80% identity，与 TatM1 64% identity
verified_claims.evidence: 'possesses 349 amino acids, a calculated molecular weight of 38.3 kDa, and belongs to class I methyltransferases'；'80% sequence identity with OMTA'；'64% sequence identity with TatM1'

verified_claims.claim: cbz 簇为 8.3 kb、7 个 ORF，GenBank PP372565，位于 5,951,197–5,959,479 nt
verified_claims.evidence: 'a possible cbz cluster (8.3 Kb, seven genes; accession number: PP372565) was located in the genomic region of our strain, covering nucleotides 5,951,197–5,959,479'

verified_claims.claim: SEC 显示 CbzMT 以二聚体形式存在；13CH3-SAM 同位素实验给出 1 和 2 Da 位移；+28 Da 对应两次甲基化
verified_claims.evidence: 'CbzMT exists as a dimer in solution'；'mass shifts of 1 and 2 Da were observed in the monomethylated and dimethylated products'；'A mass shift of 28 Da confirmed the loading of the two methyl groups'

verified_claims.claim: AlphaFold 2 建模 pTM = 0.927、pLDDT = 92.8；SAM 与 CbzMT 中 D254 形成氢键；C3-OH 与 SAM 甲基距离 3.35 Å

verified_claims.evidence: 'The pTM and pLDDT scores of the top-ranking model were 0.927 and 92.8'；'hydrogen bonding with D254'；'The distance between the closer hydroxyl group at C3 and the methyl group of SAM was 3.35 Å'
